en.text: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣设一个比喻，是要人常常祷告，不可灰心。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌設一個比喻，是要人常常禱告，不可灰心。

en.text: saying, “Therewas a judge in a certain city who didn’ t fear God and didn’ t respect man.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「某城里有一个官，不惧怕 神，也不尊重世人。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「某城裏有一個官，不懼怕上帝，也不尊重世人。

en.text: Awidow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

zhSimplified.text: 那城里有个寡妇，常到他那里，说：『我有一个对头，求你给我伸冤。』

zhTraditional.text: 那城裏有個寡婦，常到他那裏，說：『我有一個對頭，求你給我伸冤。』

en.text: Hewouldn’ t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

zhSimplified.text: 他多日不准，后来心里说：『我虽不惧怕 神，也不尊重世人，

zhTraditional.text: 他多日不准， 後來心裏說：『我雖不懼怕上帝，也不尊重世人，

en.text: yetbecause this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

zhSimplified.text: 只因这寡妇烦扰我，我就给她伸冤吧，免得她常来缠磨我！』」

zhTraditional.text: 只因這寡婦煩擾我，我就給她伸冤吧，免得她常來纏磨我！』」

en.text: The Lord said, “Listen towhat the unrighteous judge says.

zhSimplified.text: 主说：「你们听这不义之官所说的话。

zhTraditional.text: 主說：「你們聽這不義之官所說的話。

en.text: Won’tGod avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

zhSimplified.text: 神的选民昼夜呼吁他，他纵然为他们忍了多时，岂不终久给他们伸冤吗？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的選民晝夜呼籲他，他縱然為他們忍了多時，豈不終久給他們伸冤嗎？

en.text: Itell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，要快快地给他们伸冤了。然而，人子来的时候，遇得见世上有信德吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，要快快地給他們伸冤了。然而，人子來的時候，遇得見世上有信德嗎？」

en.text: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣向那些仗着自己是义人，藐视别人的，设一个比喻，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌向那些仗着自己是義人，藐視別人的，設一個比喻，

en.text: “Twomen went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「有两个人上殿里去祷告：一个是法利赛人，一个是税吏。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「有兩個人上殿裏去禱告：一個是法利賽人，一個是稅吏。

en.text: ThePharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

zhSimplified.text: 法利赛人站着，自言自语地祷告说：『 神啊，我感谢你，我不像别人勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。

zhTraditional.text: 法利賽人站着，自言自語地禱告說：『上帝啊，我感謝你，我不像別人勒索、不義、姦淫，也不像這個稅吏。

en.text: Ifast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

zhSimplified.text: 我一个礼拜禁食两次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。』

zhTraditional.text: 我一個禮拜禁食兩次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。』

en.text: Butthe tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

zhSimplified.text: 那税吏远远地站着，连举目望天也不敢，只捶着胸说：『 神啊，开恩可怜我这个罪人！』

zhTraditional.text: 那稅吏遠遠地站着，連舉目望天也不敢，只捶着胸說：『上帝啊，開恩可憐我這個罪人！』

en.text: Itell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，这人回家去比那人倒算为义了；因为，凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。」 （太19·13—15；可10·13—16）

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，這人回家去比那人倒算為義了；因為，凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。」 （太19‧13－15；可10‧13－16）

en.text: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

zhSimplified.text: 有人抱着自己的婴孩来见耶稣，要他摸他们；门徒看见就责备那些人。

zhTraditional.text: 有人抱着自己的嬰孩來見耶穌，要他摸他們；門徒看見就責備那些人。

en.text: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow thelittle children to come to me, and don’ t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣却叫他们来，说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为在 神国的正是这样的人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌卻叫他們來，說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們，因為在上帝國的正是這樣的人。

en.text: Mostcertainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’ t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

zhSimplified.text: 我实在告诉你们，凡要承受 神国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」 （太19·16—30；可10·17—31）

zhTraditional.text: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受上帝國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。」 （太19‧16－30；可10‧17－31）

en.text: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

zhSimplified.text: 有一个官问耶稣说：「良善的夫子，我该做什么事才可以承受永生？」

zhTraditional.text: 有一個官問耶穌說：「良善的夫子，我該做甚麼事才可以承受永生？」

en.text: Jesus asked him, “Whydo you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了 神一位之外，再没有良善的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再沒有良善的。

en.text: Youknow the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

zhSimplified.text: 诫命你是晓得的：『不可奸淫；不可杀人；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；当孝敬父母。』」

zhTraditional.text: 誡命你是曉得的：『不可姦淫；不可殺人；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；當孝敬父母。』」

en.text: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

zhSimplified.text: 那人说：「这一切我从小都遵守了。」

zhTraditional.text: 那人說：「這一切我從小都遵守了。」

en.text: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “Youstill lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣听见了，就说：「你还缺少一件：要变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌聽見了，就說：「你還缺少一件：要變賣你一切所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」

en.text: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

zhSimplified.text: 他听见这话，就甚忧愁，因为他很富足。

zhTraditional.text: 他聽見這話，就甚憂愁，因為他很富足。

en.text: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “Howhard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣看见他，就说：「有钱财的人进 神的国是何等的难哪！

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌看見他，就說：「有錢財的人進上帝的國是何等的難哪！

en.text: Forit is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 骆驼穿过针的眼比财主进 神的国还容易呢！」

zhTraditional.text: 駱駝穿過針的眼比財主進上帝的國還容易呢！」

en.text: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

zhSimplified.text: 听见的人说：「这样，谁能得救呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 聽見的人說：「這樣，誰能得救呢？」

en.text: But he said, “Thethings which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「在人所不能的事，在 神却能。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「在人所不能的事，在上帝卻能。」

en.text: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「看哪，我们已经撇下自己所有的跟从你了。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「看哪，我們已經撇下自己所有的跟從你了。」

en.text: He said to them, “Mostcertainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，人为 神的国撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、儿女，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，人為上帝的國撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、兒女，

en.text: whowill not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

zhSimplified.text: 没有在今世不得百倍，在来世不得永生的。」 （太20·17—19；可10·32—34）

zhTraditional.text: 沒有在今世不得百倍，在來世不得永生的。」 （太20‧17－19；可10‧32－34）

en.text: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣带着十二个门徒，对他们说：「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，先知所写的一切事都要成就在人子身上。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌帶着十二個門徒，對他們說：「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，先知所寫的一切事都要成就在人子身上。

en.text: Forhe will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

zhSimplified.text: 他将要被交给外邦人；他们要戏弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他脸上，

zhTraditional.text: 他將要被交給外邦人；他們要戲弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他臉上，

en.text: Theywill scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

zhSimplified.text: 并要鞭打他，杀害他；第三日他要复活。」

zhTraditional.text: 並要鞭打他，殺害他；第三日他要復活。」

en.text: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

zhSimplified.text: 这些事门徒一样也不懂得，意思乃是隐藏的；他们不晓得所说的是什么。 （太20·29—34；可10·46—52）

zhTraditional.text: 這些事門徒一樣也不懂得，意思乃是隱藏的；他們不曉得所說的是甚麼。 （太20‧29－34；可10‧46－52）

en.text: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣将近耶利哥的时候，有一个瞎子坐在路旁讨饭。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌將近耶利哥的時候，有一個瞎子坐在路旁討飯。

en.text: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

zhSimplified.text: 听见许多人经过，就问是什么事。

zhTraditional.text: 聽見許多人經過，就問是甚麼事。

en.text: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

zhSimplified.text: 他们告诉他，是拿撒勒人耶稣经过。

zhTraditional.text: 他們告訴他，是拿撒勒人耶穌經過。

en.text: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

zhSimplified.text: 他就呼叫说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 他就呼叫說：「大衛的子孫耶穌啊，可憐我吧！」

en.text: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

zhSimplified.text: 在前头走的人就责备他，不许他作声；他却越发喊叫说：「大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 在前頭走的人就責備他，不許他作聲；他卻越發喊叫說：「大衛的子孫，可憐我吧！」

en.text: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣站住，吩咐把他领过来，到了跟前，就问他说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌站住，吩咐把他領過來，到了跟前，就問他說：

en.text: “Whatdo you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

zhSimplified.text: 「你要我为你做什么？」他说：「主啊，我要能看见。」

zhTraditional.text: 「你要我為你做甚麼？」他說：「主啊，我要能看見。」

en.text: Jesus said to him, “Receiveyour sight. Your faith has healed you.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你可以看见！你的信救了你了。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你可以看見！你的信救了你了。」

en.text: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

zhSimplified.text: 瞎子立刻看见了，就跟随耶稣，一路归荣耀与 神。众人看见这事，也赞美 神。

zhTraditional.text: 瞎子立刻看見了，就跟隨耶穌，一路歸榮耀與上帝。眾人看見這事，也讚美上帝。
